l1: Yaad hai wo chor? Pichli baar baarah crore loot ke bhaag gaya! Is baar wahi paanch seth... par colony GOL hai! Pehla ghar aur aakhri ghar... ab padosi hain!
l2: Chor ne wahi purana plan chalaya: pehla ghar, teesra, paanchva... aur phir?
l3: Toh gol colony mein, bina pakde maximum kitna? Yahi hai LeetCode two thirteen: House Robber Two! Pichle wale ka sequel.
l4: Problem same hai, bas ek twist: ghar gol mein hain. Toh pehla aur aakhri ghar... ek saath nahi loot sakte!
l5: Trick simple hai: gol ko todo! Ya toh aakhri ghar chhod do, toh bacha seedha raasta: ghar zero se teen tak. Ya phir pehla ghar chhod do: ghar ek se chaar tak. Dono pe purana House Robber chalao... jo bada, wahi answer!
l6: Case one: aakhri ghar bahar. dp of i matlab, ab tak ka maximum loot. Pehla: do. Phir: do ya saat? Saat! Phir: saat, ya do plus nau? Gyaarah! Phir: gyaarah, ya saat plus teen? Gyaarah. Case one ka answer: gyaarah!
l7: Case two: pehla ghar bahar. Pehla: saat. Phir: saat ya nau? Nau! Phir: nau, ya saat plus teen? Das! Phir: das, ya nau plus ek? Das. Case two ka answer: das!
l8: Ab max of gyaarah aur das... gyaarah crore! Code mein bas purana rob function, do range pe call karo: zero se n minus two, aur ek se n minus one. Aur dp ke sirf last do number rakho: prev one aur prev two. O of n time!
l9: Ek line mein yaad rakho: gol ko todo, do baar seedha loot lo, jo bada wahi lo! Comment karo, House Robber Three chahiye? Aur follow karo!
